article.story: MILWAUKEE -- — Kael Robinson had 29 points in Northern Kentucky's 85-67 victory over Milwaukee on Friday night. Robinson added seven rebounds for the Norse (13-5, 5-2 Horizon League). Donovan Oday totaled 21 points, six rebounds and three steals. Tae Dozier pitched in with 13 points and 10 rebounds. The Panthers (7-10, 3-3) were led by Stevie Elam, who recorded 16 points and seven rebounds. Josh Dixon added 14 points and Amar Augillard scored 11. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
